title: Gitat ane sinni agat saduh soole migaq sinni rooci
intro: Qur'aanak galitteh addal, ken barittot nascubeemih migaq keenik yeyyeeqeh yan maritte tan. Inki tannah tan rooci farmoytit cinneh yan agattiinah fanat yooboke, takkay immay ta num ken baxissah tan uqrat tan imaan luk suge. finqittem xayyowte wak, ta num ken sirri mablal digga luk soole. ellecaboh amri oobak naharal ken ummatta takkaawisa ta mistirih yan numih kinnaane qaddoysaanam duuddaa?
clues: Anu Yalli keenih ruube farmoytit qagaaqagitak dirabboyseh yan ummattah fanat waarak suge.
yi agattinaanih inna hinna, farmoyti yi degeltak qado astooti luk temeete wak numma cedeh.
Anu inni imaan yi zulmih marak qelliseh, oson yi imaan geenik yoo biyaakele loonum aaxaguk.
Digaalah amri xayyoowe wak, Anu inni kibal qaduk warseeh, inni ummatta sinni cattuh takkaawiseh.
Anu amaanat le farmoyta kinniyom, duma ruuben marak baxsa maliiy, Yalla akke waytek qibaada akah aban innah ken kassiise.
Yi ummatta baab kee cabbu yoo malkisse, uxih digaala keenil maabitina ellecaboh keenil radde.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: Nabi Huud Aadah ummattah farmoyta
Amo'miniin Nabi Huud Ummattay Nabiyyih Shahhiid Yekkeh Suge
numma cinee Qaadah ummattah miracseena .
Nabiyyi Saaliih sacaabay yallih astootil waaga luk suge
Malayka Qaadah ummatta bayissuh rubte .
identity.answer: Amo'miniin Nabi Huud Ummattay Nabiyyih Shahhiid Yekkeh Suge

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Anu markabat catak sugeeh, Yalli faxem tam fan waara.
Yi ummatta yok wadir taamineeh, massat tan gita fan miraacisak sugte.
Anu yi marat qideh immay rooci yok yalli racmatta bee.
Anu aqayyaare abeek wadir toobiteh Yalli toobi yok oggoleh.
Anu rabek wadir yi ummatta qidda sanamat milaagimeh suge.
outcome.answer: Anu yi marat qideh immay rooci yok yalli racmatta bee.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
